svg.title: A shared clock, two trajectories
svg.desc: Source-derived unit sine motion at one radian per second. Left-eye blue and right-eye dashed orange coincide for X/X. Y/X uses perpendicular paths from a common origin, assuming no retained offsets. Not participant measurements.
